artworks.alt: Early autumn in a pink New York window nook, with coffee, an apple, a cream pumpkin and golden leaves.
artworks.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate a NEW landscape 3:2 editorial watercolor/gouache illustration for the small top-right artwork of Ariel's pink New York morning newsletter, dated October 2, early autumn. Use the reference image only for its warm hand-painted paper texture, delicate pink/butter-yellow palette and cozy NYC atmosphere; change the composition so this is a distinct daily illustration. Scene: a blush-pink NYC brownstone window nook, a butter-yellow cup of coffee, a small cream pumpkin, a red autumn apple and a little vase of russet and golden autumn leaves on a pink gingham cloth; beyond the window, charming brownstones and gently turning trees. Early autumn, not snowy winter, not spring tulips, no Halloween faces. Compose a compact, balanced still life with the cup, pumpkin and autumn leaves near the center so it remains legible in a small square mobile crop. Soft warm daylight, painterly brush texture, elegant and cute rather than cartoonish. Fully painted opaque background, edge-to-edge image, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no border, no people or personal identifying details. This is decorative seasonal artwork, not an image of an actual event or a claim about today's weather.
